title: From Abductive Explanations to Global Logical Rules for Node Classification in SGCs
abstract: arXiv:2608.17103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable performance in node classification tasks, motivating growing interest in methods capable of explaining their predictions. Recent logic-based approaches, such as LogicXGNN, derive global logical rules for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) from collections of explanatory subgraphs. While informative, these subgraphs may contain redundant structural information that is specific to individual nodes, potentially limiting the generality of the extracted rules. In this work, we propose a logic-based framework for node classification in Simple Graph Convolution (SGC) networks that uses minimal abductive explanations as an intermediate representation for rule extraction. For each node, we compute a minimal set of node-feature pairs sufficient to preserve the predicted class. These explanations are then used to train decision trees from which global logical rules are extracted. Experiments on benc

translated_title: 从溯因解释到SGC节点分类的全局逻辑规则
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNNs）在节点分类任务中取得了显著性能，这激发了人们对能够解释其预测的方法的兴趣。最近的基于逻辑的方法，如LogicXGNN，从解释性子图集合中为图神经网络（GNNs）推导全局逻辑规则。虽然这些子图信息丰富，但它们可能包含特定于单个节点的冗余结构信息，这可能限制了提取规则的通用性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于逻辑的框架，用于简单图卷积（SGC）网络中的节点分类，该框架使用最小溯因解释作为规则提取的中间表示。对于每个节点，我们计算一组最小的节点-特征对，足以保持预测类别。这些解释随后用于训练决策树，从中提取全局逻辑规则。在基准数据集上的实验...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于最小溯因解释的逻辑框架，用于SGC网络节点分类，通过提取更通用的全局逻辑规则，避免了子图中冗余结构信息对规则泛化性的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a logic-based framework for node classification in SGC networks that uses minimal abductive explanations to extract more general global logical rules, overcoming the limitation of redundant structural information in subgraphs.
